description: Turn any table of image URLs into an interactive photo gallery — and export branded photo reports in seconds. ImageGallery renders your photos directly from image URLs in a responsive grid, opens them in a full-screen viewer with zoom, and turns the same data into ready-to-send reports in PDF and PowerPoint. Key features Interactive gallery and modal viewer: responsive grid with configurable rows and columns; click any photo for a full-screen view with zoom, pan and keyboard navigation. Cross-filtering: Ctrl+click a photo to filter the rest of your report, just like a native visual. PDF export with a template designer: compose the page and the photo card visually — up to three text zones around each photo, fonts, colours, alignment, overlay backgrounds, logo, header and page numbering. PowerPoint export with your corporate template: upload your own .pptx with placeholders, map them to report fields, and get a deck with one slide per photo. Customisable viewer panel: design the information panel shown next to each photo, with your own fields, formats and width. Smart image rescaling: photos are resampled to their printed size, so hundreds of images fit within Power BI export limits. Privacy by design: PDFs are generated in your browser. Optional cloud services run with EU data residency and delete files automatically after download. Accessibility: full keyboard operation,…
